en.text:
Each Precision Hit or Hit against a <stasis/>Stasis-Debuffed target grants 1 stack of 'Rewind Again'. Maximum of 10 stacks.

At 10 stacks, summon a 'Time-Slip Portal' that hovers next to you and fires a three-round burst every 1.25 seconds, each bullet dealing <pve 49.1 /> <pvp [10.2] /> damage.

Time-Slip Portal has a range of 50 meters, experiences no damage falloff, and inherits the weapon's <link Combatant Damage Scaling [#CombatantScaling] />.

Stowing the weapon removes your Time-Slip Portal.
